## Build Info

Built at (UTC): `Wed Sep 09 17:59:46 2026`
Built at (UTC date): `2026-09-09`
Commit SHA: `f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9`
Version: `0.6.4`

#### What's Changed:
- **Developer Portal in Settings**: Manage your Apple Developer App IDs, Provisioning Profiles, Certificates, Devices, and App Groups directly inside the app for both paid and free team types.
- **Manual Profile Creation**: Paid developer accounts can now create manual profiles on app without having to reach developer portal.
- **Certificate Management**: Certificate CSR + create/revoke in developer portal, export, import, view all data including ASN1, keys, and much more metadata.
- **Full Two-Factor Authentication**: Added support for SMS verification, Voice phone call in addition to trusted devices during login 2FA Challenge.
- **Cellular Refresh**: Now one can enable cellular refresh with shortcuts to refresh on the go without waiting for wifi anytime anywhere (credits to @spidy123222)
- **Health Check**: Newer dedicated Health Check section in settings to diagnose device and network communication issues quickly.
- **On-Device Anisette**: Switched to on-device anisette data generation as the primary anisette data source of OTP requests during 2FA. No more need for Remote anisette servers.
- **App & Mach-O Inspector**: Inspect any app's internal files, Mach-O binaries, and embedded provisioning profiles right from App Info.
- **Storage Explorer**: Full view of all storage managed by the app and its sideloaded apps including caches, appgroups, tmp dirs, private documents dir etc.
- **Faster VPN peer auto-discovery**: Parallel connection probing discovers your device on the local vpn network much faster by doing a parallel probe for device services like lockdown/rppairing ports.
- **Dual Connection Modes**: Switch between LocalDevVPN/WireGuard and Remote servers as for loopback as required.
- **Account Config Export**: Export and import your accounts and sources as `.sideconf` files for quick setup or migration.
- **Full Liquid-Glass support**: Added smooth pill buttons, improved scroll animations, and fixed UI flickering in the My Apps tab.

#### ⚠️Known Issue
- iOS 16 users may have difficulty connecting to LocalDevVPN and is being actively worked on.

#### Full Changelog: [0.6.3...0.6.4](https://github.com/SideStore/SideStore/compare/239fc7c2b7f3c319d3608bd49c30d1457216d5df...f93a95c079057090bea355453ef24f6e8668dfa9)

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* **QEMU v10.0.2**: The backend has been updated to the latest upstream QEMU which brings with it a variety of bug fixes and performance improvements.
* **Liquid Glass**: UTM adopts the Liquid Glass design on *OS 26.
* **App Intents**: New support for automation with Shortcuts.
* **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Define custom key combinations (such as Ctrl+Alt+Del) that can be sent to the VM from the new Keyboard menu.
* **Improved Wizard**: Simplify the creation of emulated machines by selecting from a list of well-supported configurations. The updated wizard can create more working configurations such as RISC-V64 Ubuntu, classic Mac OS 8.x/9.x, and Windows 95/98.

## Changes (v4.7.5)
* Fixed some rare conditions that could lead to a VM fail to start and spin infinitely
* Fixed some rare crashes that can happen after a VM stops
* Fixed parsing of file paths with commas in the name (thanks @nikolan123)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the GLES backend (#7546) (thanks @cnnn)
* ANGLE: Fixed a memory leak issue in the Metal backend (#4958)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Fixed App Intents on macOS 26 (#7412) (thanks @peterneutron)
* (macOS) Fixed an error when file locking is disabled and a removable drive with no image selected is started (#7527)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed shared directory disconnecting when window is resized (#7488) (thanks @evan314159)
* Hotfix: (1/3/25) An earlier release of v4.7.5 has an issue that prevented VMs from starting. Make sure you are on build 118.

## Changes (v4.7.4)
* (macOS) Fixed a crash on VM start when a toolbar menu was reinitialized (note v4.7.4 was re-released to address this) (#7408)
* Home: Fixed layout issue with button titles
* (macOS) Fixed a crash when VM exits while USB is active
* (iOS) Support for StikDebug on iOS 26 (non-SE only)

## Changes (v4.7.3)
* Fixed a crash when starting a VM results in a block device error
* Stop button can now be used a second time to force kill a VM if it is unresponsive after stopping for the first time
* libusb: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes when using USB capture
* CocoaSpice: Fixed multiple race conditions that caused crashes during VM start
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed broken commands due to name collision (#7360)
* (macOS) Fixed crash when exiting full screen (#7377)

## Changes (v4.7.2)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when starting any Apple Virtualization VM (#7355) (We are re-releasing v4.7.2 with build 112 due to this critical bug.)
* Home: Display network details and active IP addresses on the home details screen (thanks @gabefair)
* Home: Show a security warning message when importing a .utm with custom arguments (#6252)
* Config: Option to reset UEFI without pre-loading Secure Boot keys (useful for custom TPM configurations) (#7005)
* Config: Pre-loading Secure Boot keys will now install Microsoft UEFI 2023 certificates (#7257)
* Config: When PS/2 device is enabled, no longer create USB mouse and keyboard devices. This allows older Windows install to work out of the box.
* Config: Quotes in custom arguments are no longer stripped (unless the only quotes wrap the entire argument) (#6343)
* Config: Provide a fixed serial number for VirtIO block devices (#7332)
* QEMU: Fixed an issue which causes Windows 98 to BSoD (#7342)
* QEMU: Do not create a default floppy drive when -nodefaults is used. UTM configuration will set up a FDC device and this is the only way to set up bootindex for floppy.
* Wizard: Legacy Windows configurations will now use PS/2 controller by default
* Wizard: Update OS logos to be consistent with other icons
* Wizard: Windows + i440fx hardware will now instantiate default devices (sound, VGA, networking) that should work with Windows 95/98
* Wizard: Add additional supported hardware configurations for running older Windows

apps.name: Madeira
apps.localizedDescription: Run x86-64 Windows games on iPhone via Wine ARM64EC, FEX-Emu and DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **In-app JIT: no StikDebug needed.** Madeira can enable JIT by itself through a bundled helper built on StikJIT. On iOS 27 it pairs with the iPhone it runs on: in Settings › Privacy & Security › Developer Mode, tap **Pair with Madeira** and enter the PIN Madeira shows. No computer needed. On iOS 26, import a pairing file instead. The pairing is kept in the Keychain. StikDebug still works. (#127)
- **Play turns JIT on for you.** If JIT is off, Play enables it and then starts the game. The button reads **Starting JIT** meanwhile.
- **Madeira JIT shortcut (iOS 27, optional).** LocalDevVPN's loopback does not work over cellular data. The shortcut connects LocalDevVPN, turns Cellular Data off when there is no Wi-Fi, and puts both back once the game has started, along with any VPN you were using. Add it during setup or in Settings › JIT.
- **Steam Cloud saves** for installed Steam games, on by default. Saves sync before and after you play, and the cloud copy is backed up before it is replaced. (#130)
- **A controller as keyboard and mouse**, chosen per game, with a Controller binds page. DirectInput is now a per-game choice too. (#128)
- **Setup** starts by installing LocalDevVPN when it is missing. It opens once more after this update, so you can pick one of the new JIT options.

### Fixed
- Games start faster: Wine starts as soon as the wineserver is ready, not after a fixed 2 s. (#125)
- Cuphead (#107), Nine Sols (#108) and Hades II (#119, #120) now run, and Steam app info with escaped quotes is read correctly (#118).
- JIT errors now explain the problem and offer a fix: **Pair Again** or **Connect LocalDevVPN**. The error also shows on the Settings tab.

### Known issues
- With Wi-Fi and Cellular Data both off, LocalDevVPN cannot connect, so JIT cannot be enabled, even with the shortcut. Connect LocalDevVPN while a network is available.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- First-run setup walks you through JIT. Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Dan Perks ([@danperks](https://github.com/danperks)) for in-app JIT and pairing, Jesse ([@JesseLovelace](https://github.com/JesseLovelace)) for Steam Cloud saves, faster launches and the game fixes, and Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for keyboard-and-mouse controllers.

### Fixed
- **Direct3D 9 and Direct3D 11 games run on iOS 26 again.** The graphics layer's built-in shader library was compiled for the newest Metal version (4.1), which only iOS 27 understands, so on iOS 26 every 64-bit D3D11 game and every 32-bit D3D9 and D3D11 game failed at start-up ("This library is using language version 4.1 which is not supported on this OS"). The library now targets Metal 3.1, which every supported iOS accepts. Affects v0.1.0 and v0.1.1. (#129)

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.
- Enable JIT with Madeira's **Enable JIT** button (StikDebug). Settings shows JIT and Memory+ with green checks and says **Ready to play**.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to Nick ([@125hz](https://github.com/125hz)) for tracking this down.
